description_en: Unlock one or more convenience accounts. After being unlocked, the convenience accounts can log on to WUYING Terminal.
description_zh: 解锁一个或者多个便捷账号。解锁后的便捷账号可以登录无影终端
kebab_example: aliyun eds-user unlock-users --users alice --auto-lock-time 2023-03-03 --business-channel ENTERPRISE --api-version 2021-03-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnlockUsers

parameters.help_en: The usernames of the convenience users that you want to unlock
parameters.help_zh: 要解锁的便捷账号的用户名列表
parameters.name: users

parameters.help_en: The date on which the convenience users are automatically locked
parameters.help_zh: 自动锁定便捷账号的日期
parameters.name: auto_lock_time
